plugin.note: Trolls strategy: dwarf multicannon is highly recommended because trolls have low aggression range. Use island ice trolls north of Jatizso/Neitiznot with prayer and a Neitiznot shield for better drops, or mountain trolls with Protect from Melee for a simpler task.

requirements: 43 Prayer strongly recommended for Protect from Melee
The Fremennik Trials to speak to Mord Gunnars and access Jatizso/Neitiznot for island ice trolls
Dwarf Cannon completion to use a dwarf multicannon
Neitiznot shield for island ice trolls, especially ice troll females
92 Magic and Arceuus spellbook if using Sinister Offering
Hard Morytania Diary if using bonecrusher for passive Prayer experience
mechanics: Trolls are mostly found in the Fremennik Province and north of Burthorpe.
Quest trolls count toward a Trolls Slayer task except sea trolls.
Troll bosses can be refought in Nightmare Zone after their quests.
Mountain trolls are accessible with no quest requirement and direct damage can be completely blocked by Protect from Melee.
Ice trolls on the isles have better drops than mountain trolls, appear in large multicombat groups, and can be cannoned.
Ice troll females use ranged attacks that are much more accurate and damaging without a Neitiznot shield.
Jatizso is often preferable to Neitiznot because guards frequently tank trolls and the bank is slightly closer.
Ice Path trolls are not recommended because they are stronger and have very poor drops for their level.
Ice trolls have strong Fire elemental weaknesses; Trollweiss ice trolls have 100% Fire weakness.
Mountain trolls have lower health and can be finished quickly; the level 69 version has 50% Fire weakness and the level 71 version has 50% Earth weakness.
Thrower trolls and troll generals count but are scarce, inconvenient, and have poor or nonexistent drops.
A dwarf multicannon is highly recommended for most practical Trolls task routing because trolls have low aggression range.

methods.label: Requirements and access
methods.summary: Choose between accessible mountain trolls, better island ice trolls, discouraged river trolls, and quest-boss alternatives.
steps: Use mountain trolls if the account wants a no-quest, simple Protect from Melee task.
Use island ice trolls north of Jatizso or Neitiznot if The Fremennik Trials access is available and better drops are preferred.
Bring a dwarf multicannon for practical task completion because the task page says it is highly recommended for all troll types.
Avoid Ice Path trolls for normal tasks because the task page says they are stronger and have incredibly poor drops.
Avoid Enchanted Valley river trolls unless intentionally doing a novelty or completionist kill because their combat and Slayer experience is severely reduced.
Treat thrower trolls, troll generals, and quest bosses as countable alternatives rather than efficient task targets.
risks: Island ice trolls can deal unavoidable chip damage, especially from females.
Without a cannon, standard Trolls tasks can feel slow because trolls have low aggression range.

methods.label: Mountain trolls melee cannon
methods.summary: Use Protect from Melee and cannon support for the simple, accessible mountain troll version of the task.
recommendedFor: Players using Death Plateau, Keldagrim, Mount Quidamortem, or Troll Stronghold
requiredOrKeyItems: Runes for thralls or High Alchemy
Teleport to house tablet or other one-click teleport
steps: Use Death Plateau, Keldagrim entrance, Mount Quidamortem, or outside Troll Stronghold according to access and Konar lock.
Place the dwarf multicannon where it can cover the chosen troll group.
Keep Protect from Melee active; the task page notes mountain troll damage can be completely negated this way.
Use stab or slash weapons for mountain trolls because they are slightly resistant to crush but equally weak to stab and slash.
Use a Bonecrusher necklace to reduce or eliminate Prayer potion use where big bones are consistent.
Use thralls and Death Charge on the Arceuus spellbook when trying to speed up the task further.
Use Adept Reanimation on ensouled troll heads if carrying the Book of the dead and relevant runes.
risks: Forgoing Protect from Melee is viable only with food or Bones to peaches and is significantly slower.
Death Plateau approach has thrower trolls; Protect from Missiles is recommended while running through the canyon.
inventory: 2 Divine super combat potions or super combat potions
Divine rune pouch or rune pouch
Teleport to house tablet or other one-click teleport
Food optional when Protect from Melee is maintained

methods.label: Ice trolls melee cannon
methods.summary: Use island ice trolls with cannon, prayer, and a Neitiznot shield for the task page's recommended better-drop route.
recommendedFor: Accounts using guards to reduce incoming damage
steps: Travel to northern Jatizso or Neitiznot; Jatizso is often preferable because guards focus many trolls and its bank is slightly closer.
Set up the dwarf multicannon in the open multicombat area.
Equip a Neitiznot shield when fighting near ice troll females because the task page says it is required to reduce their damage.
Use stab or crush weapons because ice trolls are slightly resistant to slash.
Keep prayer active and bring food because some damage is unavoidable.
Use the guards' damage to speed up kills; if a guard lands the finishing blow, Slayer XP is halved but drops still appear if the player dealt damage.
risks: Ice troll females use ranged attacks and are much more accurate and damaging without a Neitiznot shield.
Using Inquisitor's armour can improve crush DPS but compromises ranged defence.
inventory: 2 Divine super combat potions or super combat potions
Teleport to house tablet or other one-click teleport
Divine rune pouch or rune pouch with Fire and Nature runes

methods.label: Fire magic
methods.summary: Use fire spells against ice trolls or lower-health mountain trolls when accepting higher rune cost.
recommendedFor: Players exploiting ice troll fire weakness
Players fighting Trollweiss Dungeon ice trolls
Accounts finishing mountain trolls quickly with magic
steps: Use Fire spells against ice trolls because the task page states they have a 100% fire weakness in Trollweiss Dungeon and strong fire weakness elsewhere.
Use Magic against Trollweiss Dungeon ice trolls if fighting without a Neitiznot shield.
Use Fire spells against mountain trolls only when valuing quick completion over cost; they have lower health but worse-value drops.
Bring enough runes for the chosen spell tier and High Alchemy if looting.
Use defensive armour or protection prayers if standing in melee distance.
risks: The task page notes Magic is more expensive.
Mountain trolls have worse-value drops, so fire magic can be a supply-cost choice rather than a profit route.

methods.label: Ice troll runt quick task
methods.summary: Complete a non-cannon task quickly by killing ice troll runts north of Neitiznot while guards help.
recommendedFor: Players not using a dwarf multicannon
steps: Go to the first island north of Neitiznot.
Target ice troll runts near the guards.
Let nearby guards deal damage and distract trolls so Ranged or Magic can be used without safespots.
Use Fire spells when maging because the task page recommends them for ice trolls.
Tag each troll yourself; drops are still received as long as the player dealt any damage.
risks: If a guard deals the finishing blow, Slayer experience is halved.
The method depends on guard positioning and target availability.

methods.label: Quest bosses and reanimation
methods.summary: Handle Troll quest bosses, Nightmare Zone refights, and reanimated trolls as countable but usually niche options.
recommendedFor: Nightmare Zone completion or novelty kills
Players using ensouled troll heads for Prayer XP
requiredOrKeyItems: Protect from Magic for Ice Troll King melee-armour method
Neitiznot shield for Ice Troll King ranged chip
steps: Use melee for Dad and block his damage with Protect from Melee.
Use melee for Arrg and prepare for both slash melee and ranged attacks.
Use melee for the Ice Troll King because his Magic and Ranged defences are extremely high.
Against the Ice Troll King, Protect from Magic in melee armour to minimise magic damage and stop his Ice Barrage-like attack.
Do not use Protect from Melee against the Ice Troll King if it causes repeated knockback into the cave wall.
Use Adept Reanimation on ensouled troll heads when carrying Book of the dead and the required runes.
risks: Quest bosses are separate trips and generally not efficient task targets.
The Ice Troll King uses melee, magic, ranged, and knockback specials.

methods.label: Inventory and loot
methods.summary: Use bone and herb handling to stretch trips while avoiding poor-value Troll routes.
recommendedFor: Players using mountain troll prayer sustain
steps: Use bonecrusher or Bonecrusher necklace after Hard Morytania Diary for passive Prayer experience and prayer sustain from big bones.
Use Sinister Offering at 92 Magic on the Arceuus spellbook if choosing spell-based bone processing.
Bring a seed box and herb sack when killing ice trolls or named Death Plateau trolls with useful seed/herb drops.
Bring Soul bearer if banking ensouled heads instead of reanimating them during the task.
Set High Alchemy warning value high enough to avoid accidental low-value alchs during cannon trips.
Keep a one-click teleport for bad lure, low prayer, or ice troll damage spikes.
risks: River trolls and several quest-area trolls have extremely poor reward per kill.
Cannonballs can cost more than poor mountain troll drops return if loot handling is ignored.
